findings.reason: it changes §6's write paths and its dispatch narrative from "new module re-implements the review path" to "figure prompt + image capability added to the owners `capability.py` and the review dispatch", which is what makes the role reachable on the same lane-selection and store the rest of the plan builds.
findings.text: the plan proposes a new module and a new prompt for the figure reviewer, and a "lane that can read an image" refusal, without citing the two mechanisms that already cover both halves: the node-review pipeline (`recovery.dispatch_review_for_run`, which already composes a review from a role and a prompt and is the sole owner of review dispatch) and the capability owner (`reckon/capability.py` levels/validation plus `reckon/_backends.py:fence_capability_problem` for a lane-meets-requirement refusal). A figure reviewer is a review with a different read target and a caption-only write, so the honest change is a figure prompt plus a role/capability declaration extending those owners, not a fifth review surface.

findings.reason: it changes §4b's done-when from reading `running`/`concurrent_requests` to consuming `lane_document.read_lane_admission(...)`'s `worker_slots`/verdict through the preflight the plan already invokes, which is the owner named for this exact decision and avoids the null-at-idle and headroom-vs-slots traps.
findings.text: `_lane_over_ceiling` (feeding `_review_lane_plan`/`_review_lane_candidates`) re-derives a lane's saturation itself from the raw `running` and `concurrent_requests` fields and holds when `running >= concurrent_requests`, duplicating the capacity arithmetic that `reckon/crew/lane_document.py` already owns: `read_lane_admission` publishes `worker_slots`, `new_session_worker_slots`, a verdict and `headroom`, and that module's own docstring states the engine headroom does not account for the router admission FIFO. §4b deliberately chooses "the pair of counts in the lane document the preflight already opens" over that admission block, so the reflex reads a figure the owner was written to supersede.

findings.reason: §11 already states "one actor owns review dispatch" and its done-when (obligation defers to an armed reflex) resolves the duplication; naming the private-helper coupling only sharpens how §11's owner should be exposed, it does not change the plan's direction, so it is recorded rather than actioned.
findings.text: the review-missing obligation and the reflex both hold and dispatch the same review, and the obligation reaches into `recovery`'s privates (`_review_in_flight`, `_review_dispatch_fields`, `_review_is_complete`, `_review_head_covers`) to decide it; §11 names this race and designs one owner, which is the right direction, but the finding stands that the current interface is a scatter of private cross-module helpers rather than one review-ownership call.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan leans on `reckon/crew/review.py` as one deep module (a large parse-and-store behind `parse_review`, `read_review`, `store_review`, `review_store_root`) and adds no family of thin wrappers over the same machinery; the pre-existing scatter of classification and selection into `recovery.py` is not introduced by this plan.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §4b's reflex re-derives lane capacity inside `reckon/crew/recovery.py` from raw `running`/`concurrent_requests`, duplicating the admission reading that `reckon/crew/lane_document.py` already owns and publishes.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites and extends the machinery it names (`reckon/crew/review.py` schema/parser/store, `reckon/crew/recovery.py` classification and dispatch composition, `reckon/crew/promotion.py` gate, `reckon.crew.resumption.sweep`, the lane document) and rebuilds none of it; its one new subsystem, §6's figure reviewer, is captured under thin_wrapper rather than as a reuse gap.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §6 adds `reckon/crew/figure_review.py` and a figure prompt as a parallel review pipeline plus a lane image-capability refusal, with no statement of why the existing review machinery or the capability owner cannot be extended to carry it.
